items.title: GSK secures first lung cancer approval, validating $10.6bn Nuvalent bet
items.summary: GSK's newly approved ROS1-positive NSCLC drug, Jideytro will now enter a lung cancer niche dominated by Pfizer’s Lorbrena.

items.title: Affinia Therapeutics receives FDA orphan drug designation for AFTX-201
items.summary: Affinia Therapeutics has received FDA orphan drug designation for AFTX-201, a treatment in development for BAG3-associated DCM.

items.title: Evogene and ELEO to develop new oral PCSK9 inhibitors
items.summary: Evogene and ELEO have entered into a scientific collaboration aimed at discovering and developing new oral small-molecule inhibitors targeting the PCSK9 pathway for hyperlipidemia and cardiovascular diseases.

items.title: Crystalys banks $130m to progress gout drug, plan for commercial readiness
items.summary: The funds will help Crystalys progress its clinical-stage development efforts and commercialisation plans for its gout drug, dotinurad.

items.title: Speciality versus diversity: the four-way CDMO race in outsourced HPAPI manufacturing
items.summary: GlobalData’s Drugs By Manufacturer Database reveals the top four CDMOs for innovator and biosimilar HPAPI contract manufacturing.
